pillar.description: The strategic pillar from the Richmond 300 master plan that the project aligns with, such as 'Thriving Neighborhoods'.

problem_statement.description: The specific problem the project aims to solve for residents.

project_name.description: The official name of the civic tech project, e.g., 'participation-analytics-dashboard'.

project_description.description: A detailed description of the project's functionality and goals.

job_type.description: The category of the job to be done (e.g., Functional, Emotional/Trust, Systems/Coordination).

situation.description: The context or situation in which the need arises, corresponding to the 'When...' part of the JTBD statement.

persona.description: The user or stakeholder trying to get the job done, corresponding to the 'I...' part of the JTBD statement.

motivation.description: The core task or motivation of the persona, corresponding to the 'want to...' part of the JTBD statement.

outcome.description: The desired outcome or goal the persona wants to achieve, corresponding to the 'so I can...' part of the JTBD statement.

current_workaround.description: The current, often inefficient, method the persona uses to get the job done.

core_pain_point.description: The primary frustration or problem with the current workaround.

jobs_to_be_done_analysis.description: An array containing three distinct Jobs To Be Done (JTBD) analyses: one functional, one emotional/trust, and one systems/coordination.
